description: Teaches Runneth how a customer reads their Meta ad account, captures customer-specific report/dashboard setup, then builds one enriched record per active creative. Stages four procedure/reference docs into the brain (Account Context Brain, Report Dashboard Setup, Creative Corpus playbook, Motion CLI data-query guide) plus a thin orchestration skill. Activation merges read-before-performance and read-before-reporting guards into /agent/user.md, writes customer-owned setup under /agent/brain/meta/, and reuses the corpus-search tool from the library for filterable retrieval rather than bundling it. Meta only.

recommended: A Motion workspace with a connected Meta ad account

customize.purpose: The Meta workspace this account context describes. Used in the /agent/user.md guard block and in every --workspace-id pull during the fill-in. Resolved during activation, not at file-copy time.

installs.purpose: Orchestration skill. Activates the account-context and report-dashboard guards, runs the account-context fill-in, captures report/dashboard setup, then builds and maintains the creative corpus. Triggered by prompts like 'run aligned onboarding', 'set up my Meta account context', or 'set up report dashboard context'.
Package overview: how the three parts relate and the install/run order.
The Account Context Brain fill-in package: nine required interpretation fields, how Runneth pulls and confirms them, and the prose output shape saved to /agent/brain/meta/account-context.md.

The Report Dashboard Setup package: customer-specific standard views, saved-report trust, source-of-truth rules, metrics, thresholds, date windows, taxonomy, creative evidence, visual standards, cadence, and validation dashboard captured as /agent/brain/meta/report-dashboard-context.md.
The Creative Corpus playbook: how to build and maintain one enriched Markdown record per active creative under /agent/brain/meta/creatives/.
Supporting reference: the canonical contract for pulling Meta data through the motion CLI. Brand-agnostic, carries no account IDs.

changelog.notes: Adds Report Dashboard Setup as the customer-owned reporting companion to Account Context Brain. It captures standard views, trusted saved reports and attribution sources, metric labels, thresholds, date windows, taxonomy, creative evidence, visual and delivery standards, and the validation dashboard into /agent/brain/meta/report-dashboard-context.md. The package now stages four procedure/reference docs and activates both performance and reporting guards.

Initial release. Aligned Onboarding teaches Runneth how a customer reads their Meta ad account and then builds a per-creative corpus off that lens. It ships two parts: the Account Context Brain (nine interpretation fields Runneth auto-pulls, confirms with a person, validates, and flags, then saves as a plain-language reference at /agent/brain/meta/account-context.md) and the Creative Corpus playbook (one enriched Markdown record per active creative with identity, summary, hook, transcript, value props, and Motion AI tags, under /agent/brain/meta/creatives/). A supporting Motion CLI data-query guide keeps the auto-pulls correct on the first try. Activation merges a workspace-scoped read-before-performance guard into /agent/user.md so the lens is loaded before any Meta performance work, and treats Motion workspace settings (goal, preferred KPI, spend threshold, attribution config) as if they do not exist. Meta only, one workspace at a time. Retrieval is automatic through Knoweth; the corpus-search tool is fetched from the library only if absent for deliberate filterable search, never bundled or clobbered.
